A flowchart showing the government financial control process. Top box: "Minister of Finance prepares the Budget". Arrow pointing down to a document: "Legislature approves the Budget". Arrow pointing down to an open safe: "Minister of Finance issues a Warrant". Arrow pointing down to a desk with ledgers: "Accountant-General releases funds from the Consolidated Revenue Fund". Arrow pointing to a building: "Ministries and Agencies spend money according to their allocated Votes". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background, using blue and green pastel colors for the boxes.

A diagram comparing the old banking system with the Treasury Single Account (TSA) system. Left side (Old System): Several government ministries (Education, Health, Works) each connected by arrows to different commercial banks, showing scattered funds. Right side (TSA System): The same ministries all pointing arrows to one large central vault, showing consolidated funds.
